✅ Auto Seat Customer – Automatically seats incoming customer groups at free tables so your restaurant runs smoothly without manual intervention.
✅ Auto Pickup Cash – Collect all the bills from tables automatically, maximizing profits with zero effort.
✅ Auto Pickup Dishes – Instantly clear dirty dishes from tables to keep your restaurant clean and ready for new customers.
✅ Auto Cook (Super Instant) – Complete all cooking tasks instantly without teleporting or waiting, ensuring food is always ready immediately.
✅ Auto Serve (Ultra-Fast) – Serve food to all customers as soon as it’s prepared, preventing long wait times and increasing tips.
✅ Auto Claim Orders – Automatically claim all pending customer orders, so no one has to manually handle them.
✅ Teleports – Quickly teleport to your Tycoon, Plaza, Farm, or EKEA locations, saving travel time.
✅ Restaurant Control – Open, Close, or Empty your restaurant with one click to manage operations efficiently.
✅ Player Utilities – Includes Anti-AFK, Fly Mode, Infinite Jump, WalkSpeed, and JumpPower sliders to enhance movement and gameplay flexibility.
✅ Feedback System – Submit your feedback or suggestions directly to the developer’s Discord webhook for feature requests or bug reports.
✅ Fully Mobile & PC Compatible – Designed to work seamlessly across all platforms.
✅ Continuous Automation – Auto Customer, Cash Pickup, and Dish Pickup run in a loop, keeping your restaurant fully automated.
✅ User-Friendly UI – WindUI provides easy toggles, sliders, and input boxes for every feature, making it simple to customize your experience.

⚠️ Note: Script performance depends on your executor and system, but everything is optimized to minimize lag and maximize efficiency.
